review: Read complete SetupContractDialog, CompanionResidentControl and both test suites; read unchanged public Radix dialog wrapper and verified canonical/export parity. New files are first-party UI/test source; no new third-party source or assets copied.

Setup dialog displays exact account, installation, EXE/package hashes, declared task/chat, scope text, review revision and expiry. Changing selected purposes disables approval until a new matching revision. Failed owner inspection, expired/revoked status, absent exact scope or busy state disable approval.

The UI differentiates planned purposes from bound authority, room AI review intent from exact-source consent, setup expiry from underlying grants, personal-device enrollment from developer USB checks, and private/signed update continuation. Actual grant/review authority remains server/native owned.

Companion controls send explicit task/answer/preparation requests, display validated status and measured block differences, and keep Stop independent of other busy operations. Measured pages and targets explicitly do not prove full structure completion.

Fixed late actor preparation/native-install success and error messages overwriting a confirmed Stop. Both paths now honor the existing stop epoch and pending marker. The native operation itself is not canceled by this renderer guard.
Replaced the older world fixture label with world:fixture. Tests use literal synthetic accounts/tasks/receipts and mocked fetch; no real game world, model, account or permission is accessed.
Confirmed the parent inbox keys the dialog by request ID, review revision and review attempt, and keys resident controls by request ID. Parent behavior still requires full review.
